title: Successor machine
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a work-tape index $i<k$, define a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states consisting of a phase together with its corresponding control data: the increment phase has flag controls, the extend phase has controls in the disjoint union of seek controls and a nested union of four indices with seek controls, and the exit phase has a single control. Its initial state is the running control in the increment phase, and its transitions are obtained by hosting the phase-specific machine parts and using the phase-dependent redirects.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $k$ work tapes
caveat: The phase-specific machine parts and the hosting construction are not defined in the supplied statement, so their transition behavior cannot be described more explicitly.
